question: Why is the fruit of other-deity worship perishable while devotion to the Lord is not?
premises: The fruit of those worshippers is perishable.
Limited desire-bound worship yields limited fruit.
inference: Worship directed to limited deities yields limited perishable fruit, while devotion to the Lord reaches the Lord.
uncertainties: Long fused compounds are glossed as wholes.
plain_english: The fruit of those worshippers is perishable, while my devotees go to me; limited desire-bound worship yields limited fruit.
